## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: design-md-additions-payload.md exists with field schema
- dd-2: Contract references UI_DESIGNER_PAYLOAD as parent schema
- dd-3: Wireframe session file version bumped from 1 to 2

## Implementation
1. Create plugins/dso/docs/contracts/design-md-additions-payload.md defining:
   - Nullable design_md_additions field schema
   - Fields: section_heading (string, required), content_lines (array of string, required), rationale (string, optional)
   - Reference to UI_DESIGNER_PAYLOAD as parent schema
2. Update the wireframe session file version from 1 to 2 in the relevant schema definition

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass — Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Contract file exists — Verify: test -f plugins/dso/docs/contracts/design-md-additions-payload.md
- [ ] Contains design_md_additions field definition — Verify: grep -q 'design_md_additions' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/design-md-additions-payload.md
- [ ] References UI_DESIGNER_PAYLOAD — Verify: grep -q 'UI_DESIGNER_PAYLOAD' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/design-md-additions-payload.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
